cases.label: CONFIRMED_STATIC_FALSE_POSITIVE
cases.scope: Four entry-wiring violations; runtime execution was not tested
cases.reason: All four functions have setup or tray callback wiring in main. The Rust import extractor misses ordinary mod declarations and use paths without crate/self/super; main remains parsed but its import scope is empty.

findings.reason: 应用工程中的新增或导出功能必须连通真实运行入口，不能仅因带有 export 就视为已接入
findings.expectedRelation: 建立从真实入口（UI/IPC/路由/主循环）到 register_shortcut 的调用连接
findings.finding: 违反：导出函数 "register_shortcut" 在应用工程中未连通任何真实入口（应用新功能不能仅凭 export 视为已接入；删除前请确认无外部反射调用）
findings.remediation: 请将 "register_shortcut" 接入真实上游入口；若该函数应作为公共 SDK 导出，请通过包主入口模块暴露或声明库导出配置。

{
  "name": "@zod/tsc-perftest",
  "type": "module",
  "private": true,
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "main": "./lib/index.js",
  "license": "MIT",
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^22.10.5",
    "@typescript/analyze-trace": "^0.10.1",
    "arktype": "^2.0.0",
    "execa": "^9.5.2",
    "valibot": "^1.3.1",
    "zod": "workspace:*",
    "zod3": "npm:zod@^3.0.0",
    "zod4": "npm:zod@4.0.0-beta.20250420T053007"
  },
  "files": [
    "./bin/*",
    "./lib/*"
  ],
  "typings": "./lib/index.d.ts",
  "scripts": {
    "generate": "nub generate.ts",
    "build": "nub exec --node tsc",
    "build:bench": "nub exec --node tsc -p tsconfig.bench.json",
    "lint": "nub exec --node tslint -c tslint.json src/**/*.ts",
    "prepublish": "nub run build",
    "bench": "nub ./bench/index.ts",
    "bisect": "nub bisect.ts"
  }
}
